about: Probabilistic structures save memory by allowing specific errors. A Bloom filter may return a false positive; a Count-Min Sketch may overestimate frequency.
outcome: Inspect a Bloom bitset and Count-Min Sketch beside exact ground truth. Explore collisions and the memory/accuracy tradeoff.
